remarks: Welcome to this charming 3 bedroom, 2.5 bath raised ranch in Norwalk, set on over a half acre of level land with stunning views of the 5 Mile River right in your backyard. Located near Rowayton, SoNo, and I-95, this home provides both convenience and tranquility. Enjoy outdoor living with 2 spacious decks and a large backyard. The home features a unique curved staircase, hardwood floors throughout the main level, and a cozy fireplace on the lower level. With a brand new roof, attached 2 car garage, and ample storage, this property is perfect for both entertaining and everyday living. This well kept home, in its original condition, is ready for your updates and personal touch. Don't miss the opportunity to make this your home!
